title: Q&A Pair Payload
description: Department-authored FAQ. Highest-precision retrieval path: the answer is returned close to verbatim, so a near-miss match is worse than no match.

answer.description: <= ~120 words, in the persona voice. May contain {{ref:id}} placeholders resolved at answer time so facts stay in one home.

paraphrases.description: Real student phrasings, ideally harvested from ticket data during department onboarding. This is where containment rate comes from.

references.description: ids of records supplying live values. Unresolvable references fail the validation gate.

escalation_hint.description: When this answer is likely insufficient, what to offer next.

never_answer_if.description: Conditions that must force escalation instead of this answer (e.g. 'student mentions a hold', 'student asks about their own balance').
